title: Lumley v. Wagner — negative injunction
summary: The text distinguishes restraining competing performances from compelling personal service.
notes: The notes invite attention to the actual effects and limits of a negative injunction and comparisons to other performers and athletes. Such an injunction should not simply be labeled the same remedy as an affirmative order to sing.
